title: Entity
description: A generic data storage object representing a TTRPG entity (character, monster, item, spell, etc.) with metadata and extended property syntax.

uuid.description: Unique identifier for this entity instance. Typically a UUIDv4 or unique string.

ruleset_id.description: Identifier (slug or UUID) of the ruleset to which this entity belongs (e.g. 'open5e').

entity_type.description: The specific entity type defined in the ruleset (e.g. 'character', 'monster', 'item', 'spell').

display_name.description: The human-readable name of the entity, used for lists, headers, and UI displays.

description.description: An optional summary or description of the entity.

version.description: Version identifier for this entity data format or record.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this entity was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this entity was last modified.

tags.description: Optional array of string tags for filtering, grouping, or search.

template_id.description: Optional override of the default template used to render or edit this entity.

properties.description: The specific properties of the entity, supporting primitives, nested objects, arrays, and extended property objects with calculated expressions.

modifier.description: A modifier applied to a property value (e.g. bonuses, penalties, equipment effects).

source.description: The origin of the modifier (e.g. 'Ring of Protection', 'Racial Trait', 'Bless').

value.description: The modifier value (numeric delta, multiplier, or replacement).

active.description: Whether this modifier is currently active and applied to the calculated value.

description.description: Explanation or context for this modifier.

extendedProperty.description: An extended property object capable of holding base values, calculated expressions, modifiers, bounds, and metadata.

value.description: The current, resolved, or evaluated value.

base.description: The base/unmodified value before expressions or modifiers are applied.

expr.description: Math, logical, or string expression to compute calculated fields (e.g. 'floor((strength - 10) / 2)').

formula.description: Alias for expr defining a calculation formula.

modifiers.description: List of active or inactive modifiers affecting this property.

override.description: Manual user override value or boolean indicator.

min.description: Minimum allowed value for numeric properties.

max.description: Maximum allowed value for numeric properties.

label.description: Human-readable label for display in UI or sheets.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata for custom engine or UI hooks.

propertyValue.description: A property value may be a primitive, an extended property object with calculation syntax, an array of property values, or a nested object of properties.
